verdict.rationale: The only on-axis evidence is first-party dbt Projects on Snowflake, a documented ELT-tool integration with managed dbt Core/Fusion runtimes and a migration guide, which covers the ETL/ELT-tool slice of the story. Snowpipe and COPY load files from a stage rather than connecting to sources, and the REST/SQL APIs are developer building blocks, so neither earns credit. missing for 10: first-party connectors for SaaS apps, first-party connectors for operational databases, a partner connector ecosystem or catalog, connector setup documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
